description: This PHP source file defines the TeamDemoData class, which provides methods for creating and managing demo team data within a SuiteCRM environment, including team creation, user assignment, and random selection of teams and team sets.

classes.name: TeamDemoData
classes.description: A class for generating and managing demo team data, including team creation, user assignment, and random team selection.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for creating demo data for teams, initializing with a team object and optional large scale test flag.

methods.name: create_demo_data
methods.description: Creates demo team data based on predefined data, optionally generating additional teams for large scale testing.

methods.name: add_users_to_team
methods.description: Assigns users to specific teams ('West' and 'East') using predefined GUIDs.

methods.name: get_random_team
methods.description: Returns a randomly selected team name from the seed data list.

methods.name: get_random_teamset
methods.description: Returns a randomly selected team set (array of team names) from the seed data list.

methods.name: _seed_data_get_teamset_list
methods.description: Provides a list of predefined team sets (arrays of team names).

methods.name: _seed_data_get_team_list
methods.description: Provides a list of predefined team names.

methods.name: _quick_create
methods.description: Creates a team with the given name if it does not already exist.
